description: This file defines a class `UrlIntentListener` that implements the `OnItemClickListener` interface. Its purpose is to handle item click events in an Android AdapterView by retrieving a URL from the clicked view's tag, creating an intent to view that URL, and starting the activity to open the URL in a browser.

classes.name: UrlIntentListener
classes.description: A listener which expects a URL as a tag of the view it is associated with. It then opens the URL in the browser application.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles click events on items in an AdapterView by extracting the URL from the view's tag, creating an intent with ACTION_VIEW, and starting the activity to open the URL.
